passage: The editorial team is correcting yesterday's article about regional water use. The story said agricultural consumption increased 14 percent, but the underlying report shows a 4 percent increase. The main conclusion—that drought restrictions have not reduced total demand—still holds. The online article is corrected, and print readers will see a note tomorrow.

keyPoints.text: The article incorrectly reported a 14% agricultural water-use increase instead of 4%.
The main conclusion about drought restrictions and total demand remains valid.
The online version is corrected and print readers will receive a note.

referenceAnswer: Yesterday's water-use article overstated agricultural growth as 14% instead of 4%; the main conclusion remains unchanged.
